meta.title: Zobique Labs — AI systems built for your business
meta.description: Zobique Labs designs, builds and runs AI agents and automation inside client operations.

heading: Zobique Labs
intro: Zobique Labs engineers AI systems that do real work inside other businesses. We map the workflow that costs your team time, design a system around how your operation actually runs, build it against your real data and tools, and keep it running after launch.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: Map the workflow, model the return, sketch the architecture.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Decide what the agent does, which tools it can use, and when it hands over to a person.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Build against your real data and tools, with integrations and testing.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Deploy, watch it in production, and keep tuning it.

items.title: Lead research and qualification
items.body: Pipelines that research and score leads before your team spends time on them.

items.title: Sales and support agents
items.body: Agents that answer, qualify and route, and escalate to a person when the case needs one.

items.title: Document processing
items.body: Systems that read, extract and file documents so people don't have to retype them.
